dedupe_keys.name: annual survey of manufactures asm us census bureau

description: The Annual Survey of Manufactures provides intercensal measures of US manufacturing activity: employment, payroll, value of shipments, value added, cost of materials, capital expenditures and inventories by industry and state, plus experimental tables on industrial robotic equipment. It was produced by the U.S. Census Bureau from a sample of manufacturing establishments between the five-yearly Economic Censuses. Coverage is national with state and NAICS industry detail; benchmark and time-series tables cover 2013 to 2022, and the latest benchmark tables were released on 10 April 2025. Tables are available on the programme page and through data.census.gov, with publications and visualisations; access is free of charge and without registration, as US Government statistics. Caveat: the survey has been discontinued in this form, because the Census Bureau states that the ASM transitioned to the Annual Integrated Economic Survey (AIES), which began collection in March 2024, so later years must be taken from the AIES; estimates are sample-based and some cells are suppressed for confidentiality. For simulation it supports capacity planning and hazard exposure analyses of the manufacturing base, such as weighting output losses by industry and state in supply-chain disruption and resilience models. It complements the US Census Economic Census and the EIA Manufacturing Energy Consumption Survey records in this catalogue, which cover energy use of the same establishments.
